card.name: Capitalized word-start pieces after colons or bullets
card.fires_on: A short word-start piece (Ab, P, B) that begins a longer word right after a colon, bullet, or small linking word, often in contraindication lists like "Ab" before "normalities".

modes.label: Ab- after contraindication list
modes.description: The start of "Abnormalities" right after the list colon or bullet in contraindication sections.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS FOSAMAX is contraindicated in patients with the following conditions:<< Ab>>normalities of the esophagus which

modes.label: Other split word starts
modes.description: A first letter or two of a longer word such as pregnant, bile, or bigger, split off after a bullet or small word.
modes.example: WARNING: FOR TOPICAL USE ONLY. DO NOT APPLY TO BROKEN SKIN. IF<< P>>REGNANT OR BREAST-FE

card.plain: It fires on the first piece of a word that has been split, such as "Ab" in "Abnormalities", mostly at the start of list items.
